boundary_rationale: Onset: MT 33:20 is followed by a pe (single-witness), corroborating the onset at 33:21. Ezek.33.22 וְיַד יְהוָה֩ הָיְתָ֨ה אֵלַ֜י בָּעֶ֗רֶב לִפְנֵי֙ בּ֣וֹא הַפָּלִ֔יט וַיִּפְתַּ֣ח אֶת פִּ֔י עַד בּ֥וֹא אֵלַ֖י בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיִּפָּ֣תַח פִּ֔י וְלֹ֥א נֶאֱלַ֖מְתִּי עֽוֹד (oshb:Ezek.33.22) follows with the hand-of-YHWH idiom (matched on the construct alone, one of 7 verses carrying the construct) and the mouth-opening event that fulfils the muteness first commissioned in ch. 3 and anticipated as a coming sign earlier in the book.
